capabilities: Transcribe saved audio recordings into diary notes locally with SenseVoice
Clean up, translate, polish, or summarize transcript text via an optional text API
Extract spoken to-dos into Markdown task notes with dates and checkboxes
Review tomorrow, next-week, and unfinished task items in dedicated views
Process incoming recordings automatically from a configured vault folder
disambiguation: Does not record audio itself; recording is done by the separate Voice Diary Recorder plugin, and this one only processes saved audio files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Local transcription is verified only on Windows x64; the plugin was split from an earlier combined plugin, keeping the id voice-diary-unified. API keys and device state are stored in plaintext outside the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn voice recordings into notes, and online transcription requires sending audio off the device.

relations.evidence: Pair this desktop plugin with Voice Diary Recorder to record on a phone
Syncthing, Obsidian Sync, or another reliable tool that synchronizes vault files

requires.name: Python 3.10-3.12 environment with SenseVoiceSmall INT8, sherpa-onnx, NumPy, and FFmpeg (Windows x64)
Compatible text API endpoint and key for cleanup and API task extraction

summary: Desktop plugin that transcribes saved audio recordings into diary and task notes using local SenseVoice speech recognition, with optional text-API cleanup.
